dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    gcc \
    gfortran \
    build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "import scipy; print(f'Scipy {scipy.__version__} installed successfully')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned minimum versions for all detected imports. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs build dependencies (gcc, gfortran) required for SciPy compilation, and includes a health check command. The requirements prioritize SciPy development dependencies while ensuring compatibility with Python 3.9.
